commit.message:
Reddit: hide recommended posts (communities you are not in)

Reddit injects posts from communities you are not part of into the feed. They
carry a `recommendation-source` attribute (seen: geo_popular_hot_sort,
global_good_visits, two_hop_time_on_subreddits_6hr) and a Join button in the
post's credit bar. Hide both ways:

- a CSS rule for `shreddit-post[recommendation-source]`, so a post disappears
  the moment the attribute is set (the MutationObserver above only watches
  childList and would miss that)
- a CSS `:has(shreddit-join-button)` rule plus a `ready()` pass that removes the
  post a Join button sits in, for browsers without `:has()`

The Join-button rule is limited to the aggregate feeds (/, /r/popular, /r/all):
on a subreddit's own page a Join button only means you are not subscribed, and
hiding all of its posts would blank the page.

Fixes the earlier attempt at this, which referenced `doc` - that only exists
inside the IIFE above, so scriptFun threw a ReferenceError and nothing was
hidden.

Co-authored-by: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash <noreply@deepseek.com>
